sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Headaches and mental states of smokers.
Very forgetful, does not know about the occurrences
of things. Confused headache with pain in shoulder,
pressure in eyes and forehead; extremely sensitive to
noise, throbbing in ear.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Eructations. Stomach feels full of dry
food; sensation of fluttering. Acrid vomiting, and
tolerates only warm drinks. Sighing respiration.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Sweet sweat — attracts flies. Insect bites
burn and itch intensely. Itching rash alternates with
asthma. Burning sensation and erysipelatous inflam-
mation.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Larynx seems constricted. Breathing
impeded. Catarrhal asthma; mucus not readily raised.
Patient afraid to go to sleep.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Better, after sweat, after sleeping in
daytime. Worse, motion.
